scenes.heading: Working with influencers and affiliates on a small budget

sents.d: Working with influencers and affiliates on a small budget
Micro-influencers often deliver better ROI than one big-name partnership.

Smaller, more engaged creators (often called micro-influencers) frequently deliver a better return per dollar than a single large-following influencer, since their audience tends to trust their recommendations more directly.

A simple affiliate or commission structure — a unique discount code or link that tracks sales back to that creator — lets you pay based on actual results rather than a flat fee with uncertain outcomes.

Starting with product exchanges or small flat fees for a handful of relevant micro-creators, and tracking which ones actually drive sales, is a lower-risk way to learn what type of partnership works before committing to larger budgets.

take: Test small creators with tracked codes before bigger deals.
